photos.description: Owner headshot photo of "Paul S." shown in the Business-Owner-Information section of the Paul's Pool Service Inc Yelp listing.

hours: Mon-Thu 8:00 AM-5:00 PM, Fri 8:00 AM-3:30 PM, Sat-Sun Closed (per BBB profile; Yelp separately lists Mon-Thu 7:30 AM-4:30 PM / Fri 7:30 AM-3:30 PM, a minor discrepancy between the two directories)
source_notes: Original brief assumed 'Facebook-only' but a real standalone website was found at paulspoolserviceinc.com (GoDaddy site) confirming the phone number and a 'family-owned, 30+ years' claim, though it has no services list, gallery, or reviews of its own. Full services list, years-in-business (34, since 1992), FL license #CPC055622, VP contact (Brandy Striano), and hours came from the BBB profile (bbb.org, A+ accredited since 2013) -- Brandy Striano's surname suggests the owner's likely full name is 'Paul Striano' but this is not directly stated anywhere, so owner_name is kept as the publicly-displayed 'Paul S.' Reviews are Yelp's 'Review Highlights' pull-quotes (listing status: Unclaimed, 4.7 stars / 13 reviews). The Facebook page (facebook.com/p/Pauls-Pool-Service-100063664865691, 214 likes, 7 check-ins) exists and was located, but Facebook's login wall blocked photo/post scraping. No explicit multi-city service-area claim was found in any owned source (BBB's 'View Service Area' is a map widget, not a text list) -- treated as Lake Mary-only. Yelp's 8 gallery photos (acid-wash before/after) were excluded because their first-person captions ('You can see where...') indicate they were customer-submitted with a review, not business-uploaded.
